title: Weighted rubric scoring
description: Score a resume, sales lead or document on several rubric dimensions and combine them with weights

label.description: state header naming the document, e.g. RESUME

combine: shortlist if composite_floors >= 1 and composite >= shortlist_at; reject if composite < reject_at; review otherwise
limitations: weights are applied here, never sent (a `weights` field in a request is ignored by the server)
scores are near-saturated; there is no bias or fairness audit, so a hiring decision keeps a human in the loop
evidence_gate and route are not built: ask them with `yes_no` and `classify`
a composite within 0.1 of a cut should be re-read with samples (pass read_options)
notes: # deviation: spec 2.18/5.18: decisions are review, reject, shortlist (the composite and floors are signals, not a decision); each dimension carries its instructions; evidence_gate and route are not built; levels are the score criteria
